206-2105-5895-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
206-2105-5895-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
206-2105-5895-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Splash Portal from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Splash Portal from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Splash Portal, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

413-2586-4186.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Odric's Outrider triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat

997-2577-5478-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
997-2577-5478-7084.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
997-2577-5478-7084.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

uses.n: Kefka, Court Mage // Kefka, Ruler of Ruin

6574-7863--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
6574-7863--165.description:
Draw a card.
Human Torch triggers, dealing 1 damage.
Kefka, Ruler of Ruin triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

2178-5470-8095.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Ghired.
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
2178-5470-8095.description:
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the creature token.
When the token dies, Ghired triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

1414-2866-4986-8095.description:
Cast Lotus Petal by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Lotus Petal from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

2021-2060-4029-5902.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

1619-4605-5542-6154-6798.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5542-6154-6798.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning White Plume Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When White Plume Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing White Plume Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of White Plume Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the White Plume Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the White Plume Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of White Plume Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the White Plume Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5542-6154-6798.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

240-4050-4460-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding one mana of any color
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3967-5220-7332.description:
Cast Casey & Raph by paying {4}{R}.
When Casey & Raph enters, it triggers. Choose its first mode targeting yourself.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Casey & Raph.
When Casey & Raph dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Casey & Raph onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Resolve the Casey & Raph trigger from step 2, causing you to exile Casey & Raph from the top of your ability with the ability to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Cast Casey & Raph from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

3991-4605-5256-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm by paying at most {4}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Faceless Butcher and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling another creature if needed.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Faceless Butcher that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Faceless Butcher token enters, it triggers, exiling the nontoken Faceless Butcher.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Faceless Butcher token
When the Faceless Butcher token dies, it triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
3991-4605-5256-7260.notes: You can either cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand or for the harmonize cost, adjusting mana requirements accordingly.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

560-1251-1563-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

requires.n: Land with Cycling Cost that can be paid using one colored mana

717-2628-6436--38.description:
Activate the land's cycling ability by paying {1} and discarding it.
When you cycle the land, Escape Protocol and Bone Miser's second ability trigger.
Resolve Bone Miser's ability, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve Escape Protocol's ability, paying {1} to blink Eccentric Farmer.
When Eccentric Farmer enters, it triggers, milling three cards and returning the cycled land from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the activated ability from step 1, drawing a card.
717-2628-6436--38.notes: You can discard down to maximum hand size at end of turn to trigger Bone Miser's abilities many times.

3490-4871-5147-6829.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing any other creature you control.
When the creature dies, Venom and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Venom trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1117-3497-3689-6518.description:
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3259-5734-6633.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control other than Death Tyrant.
3259-5734-6633.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to any creature you control except Death Tyrant, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the creature that had Breath of Fury attached dies, Death Tyrant triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Repeat each combat phase.

413-3560-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
413-3560-5972.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1052-2438-6553.easyPrerequisites: Minion's Return attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
1052-2438-6553.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

573-1479-6517.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
573-1479-6517.description:
Play Gruul Turf.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it, Dragonback Assault, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, it and Dragonback Assault trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

570-4824-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Faeburrow Elder's ability by tapping it, adding {G}{W}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Soliton's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

671-2034-3097-3490.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lisette triggers. Choose not to pay.
Resolve all other triggers, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

1753-2034-2820-4679.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Angelic Renewal.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Yenna, adding {C}{C}.
When Yenna dies, both Angelic Renewals trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to sacrifice either Angelic Renewal and return Yenna from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

2035-2511-2523.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Gollum.
When Gollum dies, it and Ratadrabik trigger.
Resolve the Ratadrabik trigger, creating a  nonlegendary token copy of Gollum that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Gollum trigger from step 2, causing the Ring to tempt you, and for the Gollum token to become your Ring-bearer, thus making it legendary.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

215-729-1719-2404.notablePrerequisites:
Vizier of Tumbling Sands does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five other creatures.
215-729-1719-2404.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least eight {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Great Oak Guardian to your hand.
Cast Great Oak Guardian by paying {5}{G}.
When Great Oak Guardian enters, it triggers itself, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.
If you control nine or more creatures, this combo will net infinite green mana, which you then may activate Temur Sabertooth any number of times and recast any creatures castable with green mana any number of times, effectively "blinking" your green creatures any number of times.
You may also activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands any number of times.

1243-2510-3615-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
1243-2510-3615-4050.description:
Cast Malevolent Hermit from your graveyard for its disturb cost by paying {U}, causing it to enter the battlefield as Benevolent Geist.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Benevolent Geist, adding {U}.
Benevolent Geist is not exiled due to Humility removing its ability.
Repeat.

273-413-1475.notablePrerequisites:
One with the Kami attached to any creature you control.
Shuko attached to any creature you control except the creature with One with the Kami attached.
273-413-1475.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with Shuko attached.
When the creature dies, One with the Kami triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to that creature's power.
When the Spirits enter the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers that many times, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Shuko's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to a Spirit token.
Repeat.

1947-4316-5220.description:
Activate Reckless Barbarian by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
When Reckless Barbarian dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Reckless Barbarian on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Reckless Barbarian from the top of your library by paying {1}{R}.
Repeat.

1061-2707.notablePrerequisites:
Timestream Navigator does not have summoning sickness.
You have the city's blessing.
1061-2707.description:
During your upkeep, activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your draw step, drawing Timestream Navigator from the bottom of your library due to River Song.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

222-4050-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Saproling.
222-4050-4871.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing another nontoken creature you control and Slimefoot and Squee, adding {B}{R}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2137-2757-4642.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two basic lands.
2137-2757-4642.description:
Cast Awaken the Woods with X equal to 3 by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands you control to their owner's hand, copying Awaken the Woods.
Resolve the copy of Awaken the Woods, creating three 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature tokens.
Activate Earthcraft twice by tapping two Forest Dryads, untapping two basic lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding {2}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana and infinite land tokens, you may activate Uyo any number of times, targeting any number of instant or sorcery spells.

624-2084.notablePrerequisites: Phantasmal Image is a copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
624-2084.description: Activate Phantasmal Image by paying {1}{U}, shuffling Phantasmal Image into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

313-325-1742-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have at least six cards in hand.
313-325-1742-5256.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Toluz triggers, exiling the discarded card.
Repeat from step 1 until you have an empty hand.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Toluz.
Toluz dies, returning all cards exiled with it to your hand.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Toluz's power.
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning Toluz from your graveyard to the battlefield, and returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
Toluz enters the battlefield, causing it to connive.
Repeat.

1409-3263-4813.notablePrerequisites:
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Famished Foragers.
An opponent has lost life this turn.
1409-3263-4813.description:
Activate Famished Foragers by paying {2}, blinking itself.
Famished Foragers enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Famished Foragers trigger, adding {3}.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Famished Foragers.
Repeat.

2143-4772.description:
Activate Spawnsire of Ulamog by paying {4}, creating four 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
